tools.name: start_planner
tools.description: For a person without an account: creates their planner (new-showtime alerts and reminders included), a private agent token and a Stripe Checkout link. $4.99/mo after a 7-day free trial; everything included; the human confirms on Stripe; agents never handle cards. Show checkoutUrl to the human. After

tools.name: list_releases
tools.description: Upcoming catalog releases with your saved tier and suggest-v1 suggestion. Suggestions are advice, never intent. Use the returned filmId with set_tier.

tools.name: set_home_theatres
tools.description: Choose 1–10 active AMC theatre IDs. Rankings use only these theatres. Never creates booking intent or notification consent.

tools.name: list_reminders
tools.description: List only your reminders and their configured delivery source. Requires alerts:write.

tools.name: set_reminder
tools.description: Remind before an already booked planner ticket, or at an explicit human-selected on-sale/first-showing date and time for a known movie. Movie dates are supplied facts, never predictions. Uses an existing owned Following alert's confirmed email/registered push, and respects quiet hours even for on-sa

tools.name: delete_reminder
tools.description: Delete only your reminder and expire any still-pending delivery. Does not alter tickets or follows.

tools.name: get_plan
tools.description: Read your private plan, protected booked tickets, requests and as-planned capacity. Never creates booking intent.

tools.name: get_capacity
tools.description: Read planner capacity, not live AMC eligibility. Available to every planner owner.

tools.name: get_best_showings
tools.description: Rank existing showings at the owner's home theatres with the same planner eligibility, protected ticket conflicts and format preferences. Returns the whole ranking (at most 600, flagged truncated), never paged. Does not queue or book.

tools.name: set_tier
tools.description: Set top, want, maybe, skip, seen or declined using existing rules. Top protects booked tickets; lowering a tier never removes protection. Does not create a booking request.

tools.name: set_format_preference
tools.description: Set default format order and explicit 3D permission. Never books or modifies protected tickets.

tools.name: request_booking
tools.description: Private executor accounts only. Only call when the human explicitly asks to queue a booking. Supply a selected showing OR complete flexibility and a stable clientKey for retries. Creates intent only, never a booking, charge or AMC call. Your booking assistant alone executes it and enforces zero-only

tools.name: cancel_booking_request
tools.description: Private executor accounts only. Cancel only a still-queued request at its current revision. Cannot cancel a claimed request, a booked ticket or any protected ticket.

tools.name: search_showtimes
tools.description: Find collected showtimes by movie, theatre, ZIP and radius (miles), format or date range. Each row preserves IDs and includes movieTitle, theatreName, theatreCity, theatreState and the observed formatLabel; unknown display facts are null. Prices and coverage are observations, not guarantees; confirm

tools.name: list_drops
tools.description: Find newly observed premium showings or new on-sale evidence since an absolute ISO time, with IDs, movieTitle, theatreName, theatreCity, theatreState and formatLabel. On-sale movie aggregates retain their nested evidence; top-level theatre/format displays identify firstBookableEvidence, or are null

tools.name: get_movie
tools.description: Get the collected movie record by movie ID or slug. Use search_showtimes for its showings.

tools.name: find_theatres
tools.description: Find active collected AMC theatres by name/city, ZIP and radius in miles. Theatre capabilities do not establish an individual showing's format.

tools.name: find_double_features
tools.description: Find same-theatre movie pairs for one theatre and date using the site's pairing engine. Travel, runtime and trailer estimates are not guarantees; this never books tickets.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Read the current configured price of the one plan: the release planner, new-showtime alerts and reminders, with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers. Public facts are free. Payment always requires a human to open and confirm a Stripe-hosted Checkout URL.

tools.name: get_subscription_status
tools.description: Check whether the connected owner has the plan (planner, alerts and reminders), including during the free trial, before payment or after expiry. Does not charge or modify billing.

tools.name: create_checkout_link
tools.description: Help the connected owner start the plan or renew it; new subscribers get the 7-day free trial. Return the Stripe-hosted URL to the human and ask them to open it and confirm. Never claim payment is complete.

tools.name: create_billing_portal_link
tools.description: Return the connected owner's Stripe-hosted portal URL. The human opens it to view invoices, change payment details or cancel. This tool never cancels or charges.

tools.name: list_alerts
tools.description: List only the connected owner's saved follows and their current status. Requires read scope.

tools.name: create_alert
tools.description: Create a movie follow with theatre IDs, formats, triggers and cadence using the website's validation and limits. Requires alerts:write and a paid plan. Email needs explicit human consent and confirmation; payment is not delivery consent.

tools.name: update_alert
tools.description: Update a saved follow's theatres, formats, triggers or cadence without changing omitted preferences. Only the connected owner's alert can be edited. Requires an entitled owner and alerts:write.

tools.name: pause_alert
tools.description: Pause only the connected owner's alert. Requires alerts:write and a paid plan.

tools.name: resume_alert
tools.description: Resume only the connected owner's paused alert. Requires alerts:write and a paid plan; no paused-period backlog is sent.

tools.name: delete_alert
tools.description: Permanently delete only the connected owner's alert. This does not cancel the subscription. Requires alerts:write and a paid plan.

tools.name: get_notification_settings
tools.description: Read the connected owner's email/push preferences, timezone, quiet hours and digest schedule. Requires read scope.

tools.name: update_notification_settings
tools.description: Partially update the connected owner's channel toggles, quiet hours or digest schedule. Only supplied fields change; omitted fields retain their current stored values. Requires alerts:write and an entitled owner. Enabling email does not bypass email opt-in/confirmation or browser permission.

tools.name: list_agent_tokens
tools.description: List connection IDs, names and scopes for this owner, never token secrets. Requires read scope. Only the human's owner key can create or revoke other connections.

tools.name: revoke_this_token
tools.description: Immediately and permanently revoke the current agent token. Future calls with it fail; only a human can issue a replacement. Does not cancel billing.

findings.detail: Description of "list_agent_tokens" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_plan, get_best_showings, list_drops, get_pricing, create_checkout_link, create_billing_portal_link, get_notification_settings · Private data: start_planner, get_plan, request_booking, cancel_booking_request, get_movie, list_agent_tokens, revoke_this_token, start_subscription · Public sink: set_reminder, create_alert, get_notification_settings, update_notification_settings · Destructive: delete_reminder, get_best_showings, set_format_preference, search_showtimes, list_drops, find_theatres, get_subscription_status, delete_alert.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_plan, get_best_showings, list_drops, get_pricing, create_checkout_link, create_billing_portal_link, get_notification_settings · Private data: start_planner, get_plan, request_booking, cancel_booking_request, get_movie, list_agent_tokens, revoke_this_token, start_subscription · Public sink: set_reminder, create_alert, get_notification_settings, update_notification_settings · Destructive: delete_reminder, get_best_showings, set_format_preference, search_showtimes, list_drops, find_theatres, get_subscription_status, delete_alert

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
